AgentInvocationPayload.description: A model call finished (successfully or not).
AgentInvocationPayload.title: AgentInvocationPayload

AgentStartedPayload.description: A model call is about to be sent. Pairs with ``agent_invocation``.
AgentStartedPayload.title: AgentStartedPayload

BudgetPayload.description: A call was refused or abandoned by the ledger.
BudgetPayload.title: BudgetPayload

FailurePayload.description:
Every failure: ``error`` always; agent context only where it applies.

Orchestration-level failures (graph errors, crashes) carry no role, step,
or attempt. The remaining fields are diagnostics specific to one cause.
FailurePayload.title: FailurePayload

Limits.description:
Autonomy envelope for a single run.

Values are validated against the process ceiling by ``clamp_limits`` before
a run starts; a caller can tighten a limit but not widen it.
Limits.title: Limits

RepairPayload.description: Unparseable structured output; the call is retried with a repair note.
RepairPayload.title: RepairPayload

RetryPayload.description:
``scope="call"``: one agent call is retried after a transient error.
``scope="steps"``: failed plan steps are re-dispatched.
RetryPayload.title: RetryPayload

RunSummary.description:
A run as listed in history: everything except plan details, review
text, verification output, the summary, and generated file contents.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

payload.description: Kind-specific data; see the TraceEventPayloads schema for the payload model of each kind.
payload.title: Payload

TraceEventPayloads.description: The payload schema for each TraceEvent.kind. TraceEvent.payload conforms to the entry for its kind for events recorded by this version; older stored traces are returned as recorded.
TraceEventPayloads.title: TraceEventPayloads

VerificationStartedPayload.description: The deterministic test runner is about to start. Not a model call.
VerificationStartedPayload.title: VerificationStartedPayload

info.title: SwarmOS

verification output, summary, or generated file contents; fetch
